title: Law on Atmospheric Air Protection (Atmosfer havasının mühafizəsi haqqında), No. 109-IIQ
citation: Law of the Republic of Azerbaijan No. 109-IIQ of 27 March 2001; Azərbaycan Respublikasının Qanunvericilik Toplusu, 2001, No. 06, Art. 364 (published 30-06-2001); text amended up to Law No. 1103-VIQD of 23 February 2024
evidence: The e-qanun.az requisite (https://api.e-qanun.az/framework/3515, opened 2026-11-03) gives acceptDate 27.03.2001 and registerDate 01.07.2011 and an empty effectDate; the Legislation Collection field reads "Dərc olunma tarixi 30-06-2001, Nəşr nömrəsi 06, Maddə nömrəsi 364". The Presidential Decree No. 501 of 11 June 2001 (e-qanun.az id 3563) speaks of the Law "qüvvəyə minməsi ilə əlaqədar" without a date. No official page opened states the commencement date.
notes: Framework law on stationary and mobile sources of emissions to air (permits, limits, inventory, monitoring, state control). It is the existing register row for Law No. 109-IIQ, whose URL was empty; the official page is now e-qanun.az. title: Corporate Governance Standards for Banks (Banklarda korporativ idarəetmə Standartları), approved by Decision No. 41/1 of the Management Board of the Central Bank of the Republic of Azerbaijan
citation: Decision of the Management Board of the Central Bank of the Republic of Azerbaijan No. 41/1 of 28 August 2023; amended by Decisions No. 36/1 of 12 September 2024, No. 45/3 of 23 December 2025, No. 06/05 of 16 February 2026 and No. 30/2 of 7 July 2026
evidence: The e-qanun.az requisite (https://api.e-qanun.az/framework/55125, opened 2026-11-03) gives acceptDate 28.08.2023 and effectDate 08.09.2023; the Versions tab dates the first version 28.08.2023. The text of the Decision itself does not state the date.
notes: The rule behind the bank sustainability indicators named in the Central Bank Sustainable Finance Report 2025. Item 19.3.5, added by Decision No. 45/3 of 2025-12-23, makes banks disclose 'bankın dayanıqlılıq göstəriciləri haqqında məlumat' (annual, Annex 1 part 5: governance, strategy, risk management and quantitative data including financed emissions and Scope 1 to 3). The footnote of the Decision says '(Bu Qərar 2027-ci il 1 yanvar tarixindən qüvvəyə minir.)', so the disclosure duty applies from 2027-01-01 (first disclosure in the first quarter of 2027, covering 2026, per the Report). The record dated 2025-12-23 and the later ones carry that text before it applies; the dates are e-qanun.az's. The Report named the 'Corporate Governance Standards for Banks' only; the Decision number and the amending decision were read from e-qanun.az, not from the Report. title: Cabinet of Ministers Decision No. 335 of 12 November 2025 approving the national greenhouse gas emissions target and the updated third Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC 3.0)
citation: Decision of the Cabinet of Ministers of the Republic of Azerbaijan No. 335 of 12 November 2025
evidence: The e-qanun.az requisite (https://api.e-qanun.az/framework/60816, opened 2026-11-03) gives acceptDate 12.11.2025 and effectDate 12.11.2025; the Decision is signed "Bakı şəhəri, 12 noyabr 2025-ci il, № 335" and has no commencement clause.
notes: Item 1 approves a national target of a 40 percent cut in greenhouse gas emissions by 2035 against 1990 and the NDC 3.0 document; items 3 to 6 task the Ministries of Ecology, Economy, Energy and Finance. It sets no duty on companies, so duty_on is state_only. Family F2 is a judgement: the brief listed no climate target instrument. The annex (the NDC 3.0 document) is not part of the e-qanun.az file (the file ends at the footnote 'Sənəd Qərarın əslinə əlavə olunur'), so the record holds the Decision only.
